reviewed_operations: GET /api/v1/matters/{matterId}/events?after=|before=&limit=&targetId= (after: seq asc; before: seq desc)
DR15.required_data: events[] {seq, type, actorRef, targetRef, recordedAt, effectiveAt, causeSeq, correlationId, reason, before/after}
DR15.authorization: Active Workspace AND explicit Matter membership AND O/E/V role; Workspace OWNER no implicit grant; no shared-token fallback; reauthorized on every request, nested ref, cursor and content fetch
DR15.denial_errors: 401 unauthenticated; non-member or nonexistent -> uniform 404 /problems/not-found (byte-identical, no title/count); 422 invalid query/cursor; 503 /problems/unavailable. No 403 on P0 reads (every member may read the whole Matter)
DR15.loading_empty_error: Loading keeps origin context; 404 -> 'not available' with no detail; 503 -> unavailable, never empty; AVAILABLE + [] only for successful zero
DR15.collection_version: Keyset after/limit (limit <= 200 inherited candidate cap; default is an implementation parameter); opaque cursor bound to actor/matter/collection/filter/sort; each page carries its own asOf/sourceRevision; in-Matter total from same snapshot allowed
DR15.cache_concurrency: Cache-Control: private, no-store; no If-Match/If-None-Match on GET; response asOf/sourceRevision; singleton revision (+ETag) for later commands only
DR15.review_note: Adds keyset 'before' for most-recent-first; time-window filter stays TQ-05; security audit never included

rules: seq bounds exempt from opaque syntax/binding only
after xor before; neither = asc from start
